artifacts.purpose: The captured frame supporting one scoped UI observation.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The active UI task, OCR/annotation, or a specifically selected final capture.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the exact frame for retained evidence; a new capture observes a different point in time.

retention_rule.rule: Keep while the UI task or a selected final deliverable references this frame. Release the capture set after task acceptance and all action or evidence dependencies end.

artifacts.purpose: Resolved capture scope, timestamp, target identity and artifact paths.
artifacts.schema: skills/screen-vision/reference/schema.md: capture metadata schema_version 2 and CLI receipt
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Consumers verifying the associated observation and its selected final evidence.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore with the exact matching capture artifacts; do not invent a receipt for a failed or later capture.

retention_rule.rule: Keep with the associated active or selected capture. Retire only after that capture's action and evidence dependencies have ended.

artifacts.purpose: Scoped UIA and OCR element observations used by the current task.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: skills/screen-vision/scripts/click.py and the selected capture's observation consumers.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore for historical observation only; confirmed actions still require fresh identity and target validation.

retention_rule.rule: Keep while a current action or selected evidence references the elements. End retention with the capture set once those dependencies end; old elements never authorize replay.

artifacts.purpose: Optional numbered visualization of the retained frame and elements.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Visual inspection during the current task or a selected final annotated capture.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Regenerate from the matching frame and elements with the original capture origin.

retention_rule.rule: Remove after inspection when no selected final deliverable references this image and the writer has stopped; keep any specifically selected deliverable until its retention ends.

artifacts.purpose: Cropped and masked private image prepared for the capture's OCR stage.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The active OCR stage and an explicitly unresolved OCR diagnosis.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Recreate from the retained frame and matching masking inputs if available; otherwise a new capture produces a new observation.

retention_rule.rule: Remove after the capture completes and any specific OCR diagnosis ends, provided no writer or selected evidence still needs this intermediate image.
